purpose: Canonical legal propositions. Each proposition is reusable by pages, answers, calculators and validators.

propositions.subject: Private residential rent review
propositions.statement: For applicable private residential tenancies, the general rent-review rule from 1 March 2026 is an increase of no more than 2% or CPI, whichever is lower, subject to the statutory and guidance-based exceptions that apply to the tenancy.

propositions.subject: Specified market-rent resetting
propositions.statement: For private tenancies created from 1 March 2026, market-rent resetting is permitted only in the specified circumstances and subject to the applicable statutory conditions.

propositions.subject: Specified new-apartment rent rule
propositions.statement: A specified new private apartment whose construction commenced after 10 June 2025 is subject to the special rent-review treatment described by current RTB guidance, including the applicable CPI-based rule and conditions.
